name: When is the best time to select a view for a pre-construction property?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to select a view for a pre-construction property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to select a view for a pre-construction property is typically as early as possible in the sales process. Developers often release units in phases, and the most desirable views (e.g., oceanfront in Miami Beach or city skylines in Brickell) are usually reserved first. Early buyers have a wider selection of available units and view options, allowing for better strategic decisions regarding potential appreciation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time to select a view for a pre-construction property is early in the sales process when more options are available.
